findingsResolved.finding: A profile lookup after committed finalization could publish a cookie after principal email/membership/session authority had changed.
findingsResolved.resolution: Profile query rechecks account ID, user ID, normalized email, verified state, target membership and the exact live token hash with non-revocation/expiry before Set-Cookie. Route cases inspect changed email, removed membership, revoked session and thrown lookup.
findingsResolved.verification: Read-only source inspection; root owns execution receipt for the route cases.

findingsResolved.finding: Forwarding an extra newPassword from forgot verify could promote the preliminary endpoint to final reset.
findingsResolved.resolution: The verify route forwards newPassword only for register. Final forgot reset remains on /auth/reset-password; the explicit extra-field regression asserts proof only and unchanged account/session/challenge.

findingsResolved.finding: Preserving a pending preregistration password at activation would retain an attacker-known password when the mailbox owner verified.
findingsResolved.resolution: Registration verify requires verifier-chosen newPassword, fingerprints it, and installs password/salt atomically with activation, consume, session and completion. Missing password fails schema validation before admission.
findingsResolved.verification: Executed transaction/parity focused receipt includes takeover and ignored password-write rollback regressions.

findingsResolved.finding: Issuance response lacked remaining cooldown metadata, so rejected delivery could drop the client cooldown.
findingsResolved.resolution: Adapter computes remaining retryAfterSeconds from D1 epoch and immutable issuance expiry. Exact DTO/parity assertions now include fresh 60 seconds; hardening replay regression proves remaining 39..40 seconds on an aged fixture without sending/creating another issuance.
findingsResolved.verification: a2_client independent helper review plus a2_transaction executed 93-test hardening rerun.

findingsResolved.finding: A successful pending issuance 202 with requireOtp did not enter the verification UI.
findingsResolved.resolution: handleLogin checks requireOtp in successful responses, enters verification with an empty activation-password field and requires fresh password choice.
findingsResolved.verification: Resolved in the a2_client final 128-test receipt and independent HTTP review; not pending.

findingsResolved.finding: Initial review proposed a new REGISTRATION_PASSWORD_REQUIRED error for code-only registration compatibility.
